title: English language evidence for student visas (AU) — synthetic
keywords: ภาษาอังกฤษ
text: The English test date must be no more than 2 years before the application date. A result that expires before the application date cannot be used; the test must be retaken. (Synthetic text for system testing.)

title: English language evidence for student visas (AU) — synthetic
keywords: ภาษาอังกฤษ
text: The English test date must be no more than 2 years before the application date, and all four component scores must appear on the same report form. A result that expires before the application date cannot be used. (Synthetic text for system testing.)

title: Passport validity for student visas (AU) — synthetic
keywords: หนังสือเดินทาง
text: The passport must remain valid until the course end date plus a 6-month buffer. If it does not, renew the passport before applying. (Synthetic text for system testing.)

title: Name and date-of-birth consistency across documents (AU) — synthetic
text: The Latin-script name and date of birth on every document must match the passport. Where a romanisation differs, have the document reissued to match the passport; never edit stored values to make them agree. (Synthetic text for system testing.)

title: Qualification evidence (AU) — synthetic
keywords: ทรานสคริปต์
text: Both the transcript and the completion certificate or degree must be submitted. The graduation date on the transcript and the conferral date on the certificate may differ by at most 1 year. (Synthetic text for system testing.)

title: The five Genuine Student criteria (AU) — synthetic
text: The student's statement must cover five points: current circumstances, reasons for choosing the course and institution, benefit to their future, immigration history, and any other relevant matter. The system can check that a statement covers all five; it never writes or edits one. (Synthetic text for system testing.)
